description: This file defines functions and types for managing batch embedding requests to the Voyage API, including submitting batches, checking status, reading errors, and running batch groups with concurrency control.

methods.name: resolveVoyageBatchDeps
methods.description: Resolves dependencies for batch operations, providing default implementations if overrides are not supplied.

methods.name: assertVoyageResponseOk
methods.description: Checks if the HTTP response is OK; throws an error with context if not.

methods.name: buildVoyageBatchRequest
methods.description: Constructs a batch request object with URL, headers, and response handler.

methods.name: submitVoyageBatch
methods.description: Uploads batch requests and creates a batch job via the Voyage API, returning batch status.

methods.name: fetchVoyageBatchStatus
methods.description: Fetches the current status of a batch job from the Voyage API.

methods.name: readVoyageBatchError
methods.description: Retrieves and parses error messages from a batch error file.

methods.name: waitForVoyageBatch
methods.description: Polls the batch status until completion, timeout, or failure, with optional debugging.
